_comment: Schema mnemonics by topic (or topic-class substring). Substring-matched against topic name (case-insensitive). voice_shaper._schema_for prepends these to the relevance hook so the user repeats the framework before each lesson.
sepsis: lactate → cultures → broad antibiotics → fluids → pressors
hyponatremia: volume status → osm → urine Na → tonicity-based correction
hypernatremia: free water deficit → correct slowly → underlying cause
afib: rate vs rhythm → anticoagulation (CHA2DS2-VASc) → reversible cause
ards: low Vt 6 mL/kg PBW → plateau <30 → PEEP per table → prone if P/F<150
aki: prerenal / intrinsic / postrenal — FENa + UA + ultrasound
dka: fluids → K+ check → insulin → close gap → transition
gi bleed: ABCs → IV access → type+cross → PPI/octreotide → endoscopy
anaphylaxis: epi IM → airway → IVF → H1/H2 + steroid
code blue: compressions → defib → epi → ABCs → reversible Hs/Ts
stemi: PCI <90min OR tPA + aspirin + heparin + dual antiplatelet
stroke: non-contrast CT → tPA <4.5h if eligible → thrombectomy <24h LVO
status epilepticus: ABCs → lorazepam IV → levetiracetam/phenytoin → propofol/midazolam drip
respiratory physiology: ventilation → perfusion → V/Q → shunt → dead space → compliance
airway: preoxygenate → plan A (DL) → plan B (LMA/VL) → plan C (FOI) → plan D (FONA)
neuromuscular blockers: depolarizing vs non-depolarizing → onset/duration → reversal agent
opioids: potency → onset/duration → metabolism → respiratory depression → reversal
local anesthetics: lidocaine/bupivacaine → max dose +/- epi → LAST recognition
neuraxial anesthesia: indication → contraindications (anticoag/infection) → spinal vs epidural → hypotension/bradycardia management
obstetric anesthesia: left uterine displacement → ephedrine/phenylephrine for hypotension → difficult airway considerations
malignant hyperthermia: stop trigger → dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg → hyperventilate 100% O2 → cool → treat hyperK/acidosis
last: stop LA → airway → lipid emulsion → small-dose epi → avoid vasopressin
high spinal: airway/intubate → IVF → vasopressor → atropine for brady
hyperthyroidism: PTU/methimazole → beta blocker → iodine after thionamide → steroids if storm
hypothyroidism: thyroxine replacement → stress dose hydrocortisone if myxedema
adrenal insufficiency: hydrocortisone 100mg IV → IVF → search for trigger
transfusion reaction: stop → maintain IV access → send blood work → supportive (fluids, pressors)
massive transfusion: 1:1:1 ratio (pRBC:FFP:plt) → calcium → keep warm → source control
trauma: ABCDE → damage control resuscitation → permissive hypotension → 1:1:1 transfusion
